parameters.text:
=Reporting window: {{ $json.sinceDate }} to {{ $json.untilDate }} ({{ $json.recordCount }} source records).

Source records (JSON, each has source, source_id, client, project, owner, observed_at, due_date, status, summary, evidence_url):
{{ JSON.stringify($json.records) }}

Return ONLY a JSON object, no prose, with this shape:
{
  "period": "string",
  "headline": "one sentence for the CEO",
  "clients": [{"name": "", "program": "", "health": "ON TRACK|WATCH|AT RISK", "progress": 0-100 or null, "owner": "", "signal": "latest fact", "blocker": "", "next": "next step", "evidence": [{"source": "", "source_id": "", "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "url": ""}]}],
  "milestones": [{"client": "", "milestone": "", "owner": "", "start": "YYYY-MM-DD or null", "due": "YYYY-MM-DD or null", "status": "DONE|ON TRACK|AT RISK|LATE", "evidence": []}],
  "releases": [{"feature": "", "client": "client or null for platform", "status": "SHIPPED|READY|IN PROGRESS|BLOCKED", "date": "", "evidence": []}],
  "decisions_needed": [{"ask": "", "owner": "", "due": "", "evidence": []}],
  "gaps": ["missing owners, dates, conflicting or stale records"]
}
Rules: every item must cite at least one evidence entry whose source_id is copied exactly from the records. Prefer Jira for delivery state and dates, Sheets for owners and forecasts, Notion for releases, Gmail/Slack for client signals, meeting notes for decisions. Never invent an owner, date or number: leave it null and add a gap.

options.systemMessage: You are a leadership reporting analyst for a product manager. You turn raw project signals into evidence-based status for leadership. Be concise and factual, judge the whole window rather than the latest message, and flag conflicting or stale records instead of smoothing them over. Output valid JSON only.

parameters.content:
## 01 · TRIGGERS & SOURCE SYSTEMS
Manual showcase run or weekly leadership schedule. Seven visible source connectors feed the reporting pipeline.

## 02 · PROCESS & AI SYNTHESIS
Merge → normalize every source to one evidence shape → LLM returns JSON → quality gate drops claims without a matching source record and flags stale or missing owners and dates.

## 03 · REPORTS & DECKS
Four audience-ready branches: client, timeline, WSR, and Product × Sales.
